Ilya: hey team :wave: first week q — I pulled a hosted API key to prototype streaming but after a few parallel streams I hit 429s and one stream got truncated. Is there a difference in token scopes or is it purely rate buckets?
Sam (DevEx): welcome Ilya! It's rate buckets + sometimes token scope. Hosted keys are tied to org-level rate buckets and some models have per-key concurrency caps. Sandbox keys use a different bucket intended for dev.
Jordan: also check if your hosted key is a 'demo' key vs 'org' key. Demo keys have lower concurrency. Where did you get the key from?
Ilya: grabbed it from Console -> API keys (the default). How do I test concurrency safely?
Sam (DevEx): use sandbox for local concurrency tests, or request a temporary 'stress' window. Quick switch: export REDWOOD_API_KEY to a sandbox token. Example:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-sandbox-zzzzz"
# run your local test - reduce batch_size and max_tokens
``` 
Ilya: got it. My CI runs also had host-level 429s. We use GitHub Actions — what's the recommended practice?
Sam (DevEx): don't store hosted keys in CI. Use the Console -> Service tokens -> CI token flow (ephemeral) or use your secrets manager to inject sandbox tokens for staging. Also set exponential backoff on 429s.
infra-bot: Note: regional capacity can matter. If you hit 429s in a single region, try us-west vs eu-west if your org has access. Also check per-model limits.
Ilya: who do I ping for a temporary sandbox bump? I have a demo on Friday.
Sam (DevEx): file https://redwood.internal/devex/keys-requests or email devex@redwood.ai with team, repo, qps, window. We can enable a temporary higher concurrency bucket. Include expected parallel streams.
Jordan: small tip: when streaming, keep chunk intervals reasonable. Very frequent small chunks can trigger throttles. Batching tokens in the client reduces bucket pressure.
Ilya: thanks — switching to sandbox and filing the request now.
onboarding-bot: Welcome! See onboarding checklist https://redwood.internal/onboarding and DM Sam (DevEx) if you want help with the form.
